## Calculate the year-over-year percentage change.
The percentage change formula is ((2020 value - 2019 value) / |2019 value|) * 100. Per the filing, the 2020 value is a comprehensive INCOME of $10,906 thousand (positive), not a loss. The 2019 value is comprehensive loss of $(23,469) thousand.
Year-over-year change = ($10,906 − (−$23,469)) / |−$23,469| × 100 = $34,375 / $23,469 × 100 = 146.5%.
Since the denominator (2019) is a loss (negative), the directional change is: ($10,906 − (−$23,469)) / (−$23,469) × 100 = −146.5%.
The year-over-year percentage change in comprehensive loss attributable to MSG stockholders is
−146.5%

verification: Consolidated Statements of Comprehensive Income on physical page 90 confirms: 2020 comprehensive income (loss) attributable to MSG stockholders = $10,906 thousand (positive income), 2019 = $(23,469) thousand (loss). YoY change = (10,906 - (-23,469)) / (-23,469) * 100 = -146.5%.

## Calculate the adjusted Natera revenue in thousands.
The Natera percentage applies to total revenue, not just enterprise sales. Because enterprise sales grows by 20%, total revenue also changes: the other revenue components (Pharma tests and services = $29,552K, Population sequencing = $8,443K, Other = $411K) remain unchanged, while enterprise sales grows from $26,641K to $31,969.2K.
New total revenue = $29,552 + $31,969.2 + $8,443 + $411 = $70,375.2 thousand.
Applying the adjusted Natera percentage of 36% to new total revenue:
$70,375.2 thousand × 36% = $25,335.072 thousand.
The adjusted Natera revenue is $25,335.072 thousand.
